name: SHS BOS Executive Command Center V1 Manual Governance Review

reports_watchtower_visibility.finding: Reports and Watchtower-style visibility remain internal/admin and observation-only. No public report publishing was added.

shs_shf_boundary.finding: SHS private/operational data remains in SHS admin surfaces. SHF public surfaces remain public-approved only through existing controls.

public_approval_guard.finding: No Command Center action can mark public-approved or mutate public approval.

security_privacy.finding: No credentials, tokens, OAuth, API keys, banking data, external APIs, webhooks, email, SMS, push, shell execution, or Python execution were added.

ownership_ip.finding: Reports, proof records, client operations, and business signals are summarized as governed local posture and do not override ownership/IP rules.

route_identity_boundary.finding: admin.html#/ops/executive-command is shs_admin only. client_admin and public/no-session access remain blocked or redirected by existing route guards.

command_preview_safety.finding: Command preview actions create preview objects only and route the operator to Command Bus for review.

orchestration_preview_safety.finding: Orchestration preview actions create preview objects only and route the operator to Orchestrator for review.

data_posture_truthfulness.finding: Every layer has a data posture and no source is represented as live production data without a trusted local source.

autonomous_execution_guard.finding: All dangerous capability flags remain false and no autonomous execution path was added.
